headline: Prime angle but short-period and windy by afternoon — dawn or nothing.
today: That SSE is hitting Lido's prime window, so it'll have some shape early, but it's short-period and the wind ramps to 12mph SSW onshore by afternoon. Get the dawn glass with a log while it's cross-on and light. After mid-morning it's junked.

daysToWatch.note: NW offshore holding into a light evening, prime SE angle, up to 3ft. Short-period but the cleanest window Lido gets this week — worth the short drive.
